**Finding: compliant** (INSURANCE — Vendor insurance)

Section 18 of the Cobalt Cloud agreement meets our **preferred** position on every element, so no redline was proposed:

| Element | Document |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occurrence | §18.1 — "at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence" |
| CGL USD 2M aggregate | §18.1 — "USD 2,000,000 aggregate" |
| E&O USD 2M | §18.1 — "professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000" |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M | §18.1 — granted unconditionally, so it covers Vendor's Customer Data processing |
| Workers' compensation | §18.1 — "as required by law" |
| Certificates on request | §18.2 — "On request, Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance" |

Two favourable extras beyond the checklist: coverage runs the term **plus one year**, and §18.2 confirms "Insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities" plus primary-status and cancellation-notice mechanics. I checked for offsetting language elsewhere (policy, coverage, insurer, certificate references) and found nothing that narrows the limits or the scope of data covered.
